Description.English: Under the influence of a replenishment of northeast monsoon, Macao will remain cloudy with a few light rain patches today (20th Nov). The temperatures will gradually drop to around 14 degrees Celsius and the apparent temperature will be lower than the actual temperature. On Saturday (21st Nov), the weather will remain cool and sunny periods during the day. The public is advised to pay attention to the weather changes and take precautions to stay warm.( Update Time: 2026-11-20 00H50 )
